name: Lord Cobrahn
summary: Lord Cobrahn is one of the four leaders of the corrupted Druids of the Fang lurking deep within the Wailing Caverns. Once a night elf druid of Naralex's noble order, which hoped to heal the Barrens, he succumbed to the nightmare infecting the cavern springs. Taking a lethal serpent guise, Cobrahn now commands broods of deviate serpents and defends the twisted labyrinth.

sections.title: A Druid Corrupted
sections.body: Before his fall, Cobrahn was one of the noble druids who followed Naralex. When Naralex ventured into the Wailing Caverns beneath the Barrens hoping to tap their underground springs and restore lush life to the arid wastes, Cobrahn accompanied him. However, when Naralex's Emerald Dream communion decayed into a twisting nightmare, Cobrahn's mind shattered alongside his brothers.

sections.title: The Serpent's Embrace
sections.body: Rather than channeling the traditional totemic beasts of Cenarion tradition, the nightmare warped Cobrahn's shapeshifting into something predatory and reptilian. He now commands a deadly serpentine form that he unleashes in battle. Flanked by venomous deviate pythons and bearing a vicious clawed right hand, he oversees his section of the grottos, violently purging anyone seeking to break the nightmare's hold on the caverns.

faq.q: Who was Lord Cobrahn before he turned evil?
faq.answer: Before the nightmare took him, Cobrahn was a night elf druid in Naralex's noble order, which entered the Wailing Caverns hoping to use their springs to heal the Barrens.

faq.q: Why is he called Lord Cobrahn?
faq.answer: No account explains the name, but it fits him. Twisted by the nightmare in the Wailing Caverns, he takes a lethal serpent form and keeps deviate pythons at his side, and his fellow Fang leaders Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis bear similarly serpentine names.

faq.q: Where can Lord Cobrahn be found?
faq.answer: Lord Cobrahn resides deep within the Wailing Caverns, a twisting underground network located in the central Barrens, surrounded by deviate pythons and other nightmare-corrupted beasts.

faq.q: Why do adventurers need to defeat him?
faq.answer: He is one of the primary Fanglords leading the Druids of the Fang. He carries the Gem of Cobrahn, which the druid Nara Wildmane of Thunder Bluff seeks in order to break the Fang leaders' hold over the Barrens.

faq.q: What unique physical traits does he possess?
faq.answer: Unlike ordinary night elves, Cobrahn is noticeably larger in stature, wields a sharp claw on his right hand, and can transform completely into an oversized, venomous snake during combat.

faq.q: What is his connection to the other Druids of the Fang?
faq.answer: Cobrahn is one of the four key Fanglords alongside Lady Anacondra and their kin. They are former druids of Naralex's noble order who entered the caverns with Naralex and jointly fell to the twisting corruption of the nightmare.

angles.text: Cobrahn serves as a grim warning of how druidic shapeshifting can be perverted when connected to the nightmare rather than natural balance.
For night elves, Cobrahn's fall is a bitter tragedy, seeing a skilled brother of the Cenarion Circle abandon his heritage to lead monsters in the subterranean depths.
Horde adventurers seek Cobrahn to end the foul corruption leaking into the Barrens and protect the fragile ecosystem of Kalimdor's plains.
